cc:Work.dc:title: FineWeb-Edu GPU validation loss
cc:Work.dc:description: Recorded validation losses from 2 FineWeb-Edu training run(s). The 100M observation is one author-reported final endpoint at 98304000 positions / validation 4.623868, shown as a square without a learning curve. The 500M run has 153 saved validation estimates. Every validation point occurs after its optimizer update; processed positions = (logged step + 1) * 32768. No initial validation point, smoothing, or synthetic measurements. The larger run completes 15258 updates, processes 499974144 token positions, and finishes at validation 3.642228. Natural-log cross-entropy per GPT-2 token. Both runs evaluate the same held-out data, with different training horizons. Training and validation estimates use different batches. Sources: author's final 100M log excerpt; fineweb-500m.log.
